title: What Water Bottle Capacity Should a Corporate Wellness Program Order in Bulk?
description: A practical B2B guide to choosing 500ml, 750ml or larger water bottle capacity for a corporate wellness program, with fit, refill, packing and reorder checks.
intro: Ask what the program is trying to support and where the bottle will be carried. A desk giveaway, a commuting kit, a warehouse hydration program, a sports event and a retail-style employee benefit can have different capacity priorities. Write down recipient groups, refill access, expected carry distance, bag or cup-holder limits, event duration, decoration area and whether the bottle is a daily item or a campaign gift. The goal is not to prescribe medical intake or promise behavior change. It is to select a physical product people can carry, use and recognize. A written behavior brief lets purchasing compare 500ml, 750ml and larger options on the same assumptions instead of choosing from a product photo.
coverAlt: Natural product photograph comparing 500ml, 750ml and 1L-class bottles for corporate wellness procurement; confirm exact model dimensions and packing before ordering.
